newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's Ciller says to lead country by end-June.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Ciller says to lead country by end-June.

text.p: Turkey's Deputy Prime Minister Tansu Ciller said on Sunday she would take over the premiership by the end of June ahead of early elections within a "reasonable" time to solve a government crisis.

"It was seen as suitable to go to elections in a reasonable time...The prime ministership will change hands by the end of the month," Ciller told a news conference. Under the government protocol Ciller is set to take over the prime minister's post in the case of elections.
